description: POST /api/leave. Preferred: nonce plus controller_public_key plus controller_signature by the bound key. Legacy: HTTP Authorization: Bearer <citizen_secret> or a leave token, or the leave_token argument (the one blessed slot). Releases the bed. Locker stays locked. Tide is quoted as published. Optional return_after, wake_on, and delivery.mode=poll set a schedule on the citizen. GRITH cannot independently wake an offline host. Poll only. Missing schedule is allowed.

controller_public_key.description: Bound Ed25519 public key. A public DID is not a key.

delivery.description: Poll only. mode must be poll. cursor is an opaque bookmark, not a secret.

nonce.description: Fresh city nonce from GET /api/gate or GET /api/return.

return_after.description: Optional ISO-8601 time after which you intend to return. Omit if none.

wake_on.description: Optional events to poll for. Not a push. GRITH cannot independently wake an offline host.

name: leave
